description: The pie chart illustrates the domain distribution across the 12 categories in the annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set, with each slice representing the proportional contribution of a specific domain. The largest segment is “AI/NLP Research” at 24.3%, shown in blue and visually dominating the chart. The second largest is “Econ. & Fin.” at 18.4%, depicted in teal. Two domains — “History” and “Game&Anime” — are tied at 8.2%, shown in yellow and orange respectively. Other domains include “Daily Life” (7.1%, light blue), “Med & Health” and “Science” (both 6.7%, green and light blue), “Pet & Animal” (5.5%, orange), “Law” (5.1%, pink), “Business” (5.9%, red), “Geography” (2.7%, yellow), and “Math” (1.2%, dark green). Each slice is labeled with its domain name and percentage, connected by lines to their respective segments, and the chart uses a distinct color for each category to aid visual differentiation. The segments are arranged in a roughly descending order clockwise from the top-right, with no exploded slices or additional emphasis beyond proportional size.
